77:1763.name: Picture Postcard
77:1763.description: Picture postcard: one of the postcard's two types (the archetype Postcard/* are the other). A generated front (swap Front's image fill) in a cream mat (--jk-genre-picture-mat) and a 10px ink border, 1536×1024, scaled not reflowed. Live type on top: a title (Inter Black 148, cream, hard ink shadow) only on art-only fronts; a location ribbon; a story label tilted 2° in the bottom corner the hero isn't standing in (mirror to the left). With a title on, code moves the ribbon under the title. Ink, cream and ribbon are the front's series' own (--jk-genre-picture-<series>-*), shown here in Western with the orange ribbon; Dark Teal and Brown ribbons take cream text. Story and location copy is the library's own (STORY_STARTERS). Code: PicturePostcard (jkidd-ds, #/postcards).
